title: Sunday Night Revival: The Power of the Pastor's Rod
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message about living a life of obedience and trust in Jesus, despite the challenges and uncertainties that come our way. In this sermon, Pastor Chris shares a personal story of how God supernaturally intervened in the midst of a difficult time, and challenges listeners to have a similar breakthrough in their own lives. With humor, humility, and a deep understanding of God's heart, Pastor Chris encourages listeners to surrender to God's will and trust in His provision.
